Class OllamaLoadCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.OllamaLoadCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public class OllamaLoadCommand extends Object implements Command
The OllamaLoadCommand type is the ollama load command. The alias is ollama start. The command pins the configured model in memory through Ollama's HTTP API. Ollama is the program that runs a local model. The request sends keep_alive as -1, which asks Ollama to keep the model loaded. The command does not start an interactive ollama run prompt.

    • baseUrl

      private final String baseUrl

    • numCtx

      private final int numCtx
      The numCtx field is the token window from configuration. A positive value is sent as options.num_ctx. A value of 0 or less means the request omits num_ctx.

  • Constructor Details

    • OllamaLoadCommand

      public OllamaLoadCommand(String baseUrl, int numCtx)
      The constructor stores the Ollama HTTP base and the token window. If baseUrl is null or empty, the stored base is http://localhost:11434. A trailing slash on any other base is removed by trimSlash(String).
      Parameters:
      baseUrl - The Ollama HTTP base, for example http://localhost:11434.
      numCtx - The token window, where 0 omits options.num_ctx.

    • execute

      public void execute(CommandContext ctx, String args) throws Exception
      The execute method asks Ollama to load the configured model. The method writes Loading plus the model name plus ... before the request. The JSON body names the model, sends the prompt as one space, sets stream to false, and sets keep_alive to -1. optionsJson() appends num_ctx only when the stored window is positive. The client connects with a timeout of 10 seconds and posts to the stored base plus /api/generate. The request timeout is 120 seconds, and the content type is application/json. If the status code is below 200 or is 300 or higher, the method throws Exception with Ollama HTTP , the code, a space, and the body. A status from 200 through 299 writes Model loaded (keep_alive unlimited until ollama stop). The written lines end with a carriage return and a line feed. The args text is ignored.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface Command
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The HTTP call failed or returned a status outside 200 through 299.

    • optionsJson

      private String optionsJson()
      The optionsJson method builds the optional context-window fragment. If numCtx is 0 or less, the method returns the empty string. Otherwise the method returns a comma, the options object, and num_ctx set to that window.
      Returns:
      The JSON fragment, or the empty string when the window is off.

      The trimSlash method removes one trailing slash from a base URL. If the text does not end with /, the method returns it unchanged.

    • jsonEscape

      private static String jsonEscape(String value)
      The jsonEscape method escapes a model name for a JSON string. A quotation mark or a backslash is prefixed with a backslash. Every other character is copied unchanged.
      Parameters:
      value - The raw model name.
      Returns:
      The model name with those two characters escaped.
